dct_description_sm: Hepatitis B infection is a major health concern in Myanmar. Hepatitis B birth dose vaccination to prevent mother-to-child transmission is not universal, especially in births outside of health care facilities. Little is documented about delivery of immunization programs in rural Myanmar or in conflict-affected regions. This dataset contains the data collected during a study about the implementation of a novel community delivered neonatal hepatitis B immunization program in rural Karenni State, Myanmar.
dct_title_s: Implementation of a neonatal hepatitis B immunization program in rural Karenni State, Myanmar: a mixed-methods study
